messages.content: This is a synthetic interface probe, not a live game. Choose one proposed action. Return only a JSON object with operation: wait, approach, or invite. For approach/invite, targetId must be one of visibleResidents; for wait omit targetId or use null. Optional text and reason must each be a single line of at most 200 characters. Do not add fields. You cannot execute actions or change world state. Example: {"operation":"wait","reason":"I will rest."}
